description: This file defines the LuceneSearchEngine class, which implements search functionality using Lucene within the SuiteCRM platform. It handles search queries, caching, and access control for search results.

classes.name: LuceneSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class that uses Lucene for full-text search within SuiteCRM, supporting caching and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search engine by retrieving the index from the AOD_Index bean.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query, measures execution time, and returns search results with total hits.

methods.name: runLucene
methods.description: Performs the actual Lucene search, utilizing cache if available, and returns hits.

methods.name: validateCacheStructure
methods.description: Validates the structure of cached search results.

methods.name: newHit
methods.description: Performs a new search using Lucene, applies access control, and caches results.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Parses raw hits into structured search results, applying pagination.

methods.name: cacheQuery
methods.description: Caches search results for a query.
